name: adminer
title: Adminer
description: A web page to browse and edit a database, behind a user name and password.
notes: Adminer is at https://{{domain}}, behind Team only: its user name is team, and its password is shown once after Create. At its own login, give the address of a database this server can reach (a database inside another Caravana app is not reachable by name).

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Domain
inputs.help: Its DNS must point at this server.
